title: Master Test Plan: Automotive Dealership CRM (DealerIQ AI)
author: Muhammad Arslan (Associate SQA Engineer)
overview: This test plan outlines the quality assurance strategy, test scope, environment configurations, execution workflow, and acceptance criteria for validating DealerIQ AI release cycles at Hatzs Dimensions.

inScope: AI Telephony & Voice Agent call disposition logging and webhook retries
Lead pipeline management, drag-and-drop Kanban status updates
Deal negotiation module: vehicle trade-in appraisals, dealer fee calculations, tax logic
Paperwork document generation and carrier shipment dispatch status
Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Sales Manager, BDC Rep, Viewer)
REST API contract testing via Postman (Auth, Leads, Deals, Webhooks)
outOfScope: Core AI LLM model training weights and fine-tuning datasets
Direct carrier logistics telematics hardware sensors
Payment gateway banking infrastructure compliance (handled by external provider)

strategy.methodology: Agile SQA with shift-left API validation and exploratory risk-based passes
testLevels: Smoke & Sanity Testing on fresh deployments
Detailed Functional Testing on new feature tickets
API Testing using Postman collections with automated schema assertions

environments.name: Staging / QA
environments.database: PostgreSQL 16 replica with sanitized test seeds

environments.name: Sandbox Telephony
environments.purpose: Simulating Twilio / carrier webhooks and retry backoff intervals

entryCriteria: Feature code deployed to Staging with clean build status
Jira ticket has clear acceptance criteria and Figma designs attached
Smoke test suite passes 100% on target environment
exitCriteria: 100% of planned regression test cases executed
0 open Critical or High severity defects
All medium severity bugs documented with stakeholder sign-off
Automated smoke and regression suite passing on CI/CD pipeline
QA sign-off report issued to engineering lead and product manager

defectManagement.workflow: Open -> In Development -> Ready for Retest -> QA Verified -> Closed
